study.input: Study group for 8 people on Wednesday 4-6pm, we just need a whiteboard. Library if possible.

pizza.input: ACM coding night for 45 members Thursday 6-9pm in Thornton. We'll have pizza and need a projector.

writer.headline: Almost there — move to a room that allows food
writer.explanation: Your coding night fits Thornton Hall 326 on size and equipment, but classrooms in Thornton don't allow food (FOOD-01). Cesar Chavez Student Center 204 seats 60, allows food, and has a projector, so everything else stays the same. Because you're serving pizza, a Temporary Food Permit (FOOD-02) is required — we've pre-filled it from your request.
writer.permitNarrative: ACM will host a coding night for approximately 45 student members. Pizza will be ordered from a licensed vendor and delivered ready to serve; no on-site cooking. Leftovers will be removed and the room reset by 9:00 PM.

speaker.input: Pre-Med Society panel with 150 attendees and two guest speakers from UCSF, Tuesday 5-7pm. We need mics and a projector.

ambiguities.question: Will food or refreshments be served at the panel?

writer.headline: Staff review required — briefing prepared
writer.explanation: This panel is larger than 100 people (SIZE-02) and includes speakers from outside SFSU (GUEST-01), so it needs a staff review before confirmation. We've prepared a briefing for Student Activities & Events and pre-filled the speaker registration (GUEST-02).
writer.permitNarrative: Two guest speakers from UCSF will present on careers in medicine, followed by audience Q&A.

briefing.summary: Pre-Med Society requests a 2-hour speaker panel on Tuesday, Oct 6 (5–7 PM) for ~150 attendees with two external speakers from UCSF. Business Building 120 fits on capacity and AV.

riskPoints.point: 150 expected attendees — confirm staffing and check-in plan.
External speakers on campus — confirm whether the event is open to the public.
Speaker registration pre-filled; speaker names still needed.

staffQuestions: Is the event open to non-SFSU attendees beyond the two speakers?
Will refreshments be served? (Not stated in the request.)
Who is the on-site event lead?

dance.input: Dance practice for 25 of our members Thursday 9:30-11pm at the Village community room, we'll bring a speaker for music.

writer.headline: Move to a sound-isolated studio
writer.explanation: The Village community room is inside a residential area, so amplified sound must end by 8 PM (SOUND-02), and amplified sound after 9 PM needs a sound-isolated room (SOUND-01). Gymnasium 129 is a mirrored, sound-isolated dance studio open until 11 PM — a better fit for practice.
